import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,w,h,k = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s = np.sin(w*t)
    sq = np.sqrt(P)
